'''Assimilated Big Spiders''' are classified as [[Assimilated Mobs]], despite not having a Sane Variant. The Assimilated Big Spider does not currently have an [[Assimara Parasites|Assimara form]], nor a [[Feral Parasites|Feral Form]], much like [[Assimilated Squid|Assimilated Squids]] and the [[Assimilated Ender Dragon]].

== ''Spawning'' ==
*Spawns in groups of 3 to 5, from [[Evolution Phases#Phase 2|Phase 2]] through [[Evolution Phases#Phase 7|Phase 7]], with a spawnweight of 25.
*Spawns inside the [[Parasite Biome]], with a spawnweight of 60.
*Spawned by [[Stage II Beckon|Stage II]] and [[Stage III Beckon|Stage III Beckons]].

== ''Behavior'' ==
Assimilated Big Spiders are both Melee and Ranged Combatants.

*Their Melee Attack is performed through contact damage.
*Assimilated Big Spiders can shoot a projectile which creates [[Thin Webbing]] upon landing. These will slow down their target. These Webs disappear, after enough time passes.
*Any Mob within 3 blocks of an Assimilated Big Spider will be inflicted with [[Call Of The Hive|COTH]]. This does not go through walls.
*Assimilated Big Spiders are able to traverse faster in liquids by performing small leaps.
*On death, Assimilated Big Spiders have a chance to blow up similar to an Assimilated [[Remains]] explosion. Unlike other mobs, The Assimilated Big Spiders' explosion presents blue particles and does not create Remain blocks. This explosion still creates an effect cloud of stacking Poison and [[Call Of The Hive|COTH]] and spawns 5 [[Buglin|Buglins]].
{{Variants|count=1|Texture=Dorpa2.webp|TextureName=Second|TextureDesc=presents Half HP compared to a Normal Assimilated Big Spider.}}

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===

* Assimilated Big Spiders, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.
{{Properties|tier=Assimilated}}

== ''Trivia'' ==
*Assimilated Big Spiders are also known as '''Dorpa''' in the Mod Files.
**This implies that the Assimilated Big Spider is a different species than the rest of the Assimilated mobs, which are known as '''Inf[mob name]'''. This is also hinted at in the [[Compendium]].
*As of now, Assimilated Big Spiders are one of the few Parasites that possess eyes. It is unknown if they'll be removed or not.
